text:
emma: Quick thread to lock the benchmark narrative for launch. Goal: one clear ops+econ claim, two visual panels (scatter cost vs median latency + tail heatmap), and a 1-page cost-levers breakdown. Thoughts?

josh: Ops buyers want p99 guarantees and variance numbers. Hero claim idea: "Predictable p99 at scale, lower unit $ with routing & quantization."

rachel: Visuals: scatter + small heatmap by seq len. Also include a tiny flow diagram showing hosted -> dedicated -> private fallback. I can mock both.

dev-bot: deploy preview for demo env available: https://staging.redwood.internal/demo (internal).

emma: We need a reproducibility appendix. Josh can you confirm models/seqs and sample sizes?

josh: Proposed cells: models [redwood-small, redwood-large, open-baseline], seqs [64,256,2048], N=15k per cell. We'll report p50/p95/p99 + 95% CI. CSV example for viz ingest:```csv
model,seq_len,samples,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1m
redwood-small,64,15000,11,27,75,850
redwood-small,256,15000,33,85,210,1300
open-baseline,256,15000,62,160,380,2500
```

bench-bot: benchmark run 2026-04-12T18:00Z complete. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/launch/bench-2026-04-12.tar.gz (internal).

emma: Next steps: (1) josh finalize CSVs + appendix by EOD tomorrow, (2) rachel drop visual mocks by Wed, (3) emma + rachel draft two hero copy variants (ops-first / econ-first). We'll aim to freeze visuals Thurs for webinar rehearsal next week.

rachel: I'll also make a 1-slide appendix describing measurement noise and CI.

josh: I'll include a short note on batch-size tuning and expected cost delta at 95% utilization.

emma: Perfect. I'll create a Notion brief and assign tasks. Thanks all.
